mapper.select: SELECT TASK_ID, BID_CASE_ID, TEAM, STATUS, PROGRESS_PCT, DRAFT_CONTENT, ASSIGNEE, APPROVER, FINAL_APPROVER FROM TASKS WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
SELECT TASK_ID, TEAM, STATUS, PROGRESS_PCT, ASSIGNEE, APPROVER FROM TASKS WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} ORDER BY TEAM
SELECT TEAM FROM TASKS WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TASKS (TASK_ID, BID_CASE_ID, TEAM, STATUS, PROGRESS_PCT) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{bidCaseId}, #{team}, '대기', 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE TASKS SET ASSIGNEE = #{userId}, STATUS = CASE WHEN STATUS = '대기' THEN '작성중' ELSE STATUS END WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ASSIGNEE IS NULL
UPDATE TASKS SET APPROVER = #{userId} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND APPROVER IS NULL
UPDATE TASKS SET FINAL_APPROVER = #{userId} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND FINAL_APPROVER IS NULL
UPDATE TASKS SET DRAFT_CONTENT = #{draftContent,jdbcType=CLOB} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
UPDATE TASKS SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
UPDATE TASKS SET STATUS = #{status}, PROGRESS_PCT = #{progressPct} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
